items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: That's -- what do you call them, Celia and Margo.

ctx.x: In other words, you took a tune from the show and made an arrangement of it.

No, we were supposed to have this tune originally in (inaudible) the show. They lied, the guy (inaudible). well supposed to give it to us do this exclusively. And we'll just put a singer. That's -- what do you call them, Celia and Margo. They were going to have it exclusively. So we made it.
You could use the same track, or have them play it over again?
